scope: Career residual source-shorthand membership (6) + source-list quantifier (4)

evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下）》
evidence_catalog.source_excerpt: 若紫徽无煞曜同度，却有辅佐吉曜同会，又见禄马交驰，或会廉贞化禄、贪狼化禄、武曲化禄者，主职掌财权，从政亦为财赋税之官。
evidence_catalog.finding: The source itself enumerates the three 化禄 carriers; the compressed Career condition '财星化禄' is not the literal source logic.

evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下）》
evidence_catalog.source_excerpt: 若见刑曜，则以从事武职为佳，权力甚重。
evidence_catalog.finding: 刑曜 is used as a source functional label; this passage does not provide a closed member set.

evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下）》
evidence_catalog.source_excerpt: 太阳亦喜三台八座，恩光天贵等杂曜朝拱，皆有助于事业。
evidence_catalog.finding: 三台八座 and 恩光天贵 are named paired surfaces followed by 等杂曜; the source is exemplary/open rather than a closed flat list.

evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下）》
evidence_catalog.source_excerpt: 武曲与火铃同度，则不喜更落于巳午二宫，亦不喜多见属火的星曜，否则一生至少有一次卸职或失业。
evidence_catalog.finding: The source says 属火的星曜 and 多见; neither the elemental category membership nor the cardinal threshold is closed here.

evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下）》
evidence_catalog.source_excerpt: 『武破』在事业宫，与铃星、陀罗、阴煞、华盖、天刑同度者，为偏门或半偏行业。
evidence_catalog.finding: All five star names are explicit, but the punctuation does not safely establish ANY/ALL/N_OF semantics.

evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下）》
evidence_catalog.source_excerpt: [天同巨门]可从事饮食业，见天厨、火星同度者尤然。
evidence_catalog.finding: Both star names are explicit; the source does not add an explicit conjunction/quantifier sufficient to universalize the list semantics.

evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下）》
evidence_catalog.source_excerpt: [廉相]会禄(武曲化禄为上，禄存次之)，或会天府化科，宜握财权。
evidence_catalog.finding: The parenthetical explicitly resolves 会禄 locally as alternatives with an ordinal preference, and the following 或 is explicit.

evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下）》
evidence_catalog.source_excerpt: 卯酉宫[廉贞破军]必须见禄然后始主事业有成。以廉贞化禄事业较为顺遂。若破军化禄，则不但多劳，而且事业必有挫折。
evidence_catalog.finding: The adjacent text gives two 化禄 realizations but does not state that these exhaust all meanings of 见禄; closed membership remains unsafe.

evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下）》
evidence_catalog.source_excerpt: 天相守事业宫而为刑忌来会，更见煞曜同度，斗生牛马。有吉曜同会，亦时受压力。
evidence_catalog.finding: 刑忌 is source compound wording; the passage does not define a closed member set or a globally reusable composition operator.

evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下）》
evidence_catalog.source_excerpt: 与空劫同度，见吉辅者，创新之能力极强，此时却又喜昌曲相济。
evidence_catalog.finding: 吉辅 remains a qualified favorable-support label. The separate 昌曲 clause is evidence against silently equating 吉辅 with every member of 辅佐八曜.

records.source_repair: Replace compressed 财星化禄 with source-explicit alternatives 廉贞化禄 / 贪狼化禄 / 武曲化禄.
records.normalized_expression: NEGATED_OPEN_CATEGORY(煞) AND GROUP(辅佐) AND [GROUP(禄马) OR TRANSFORM(廉贞,化禄) OR TRANSFORM(贪狼,化禄) OR TRANSFORM(武曲,化禄)]
records.reason: The shorthand was introduced by projection compression, not by the reviewed source sentence.
Source usage establishes a meaningful category label but not a closed member registry.

records.source_repair: Preserve source relation 朝拱 and open-tail marker 等杂曜; do not flatten into a closed four-star list.
records.normalized_expression: RELATION(朝拱,SOURCE_EXAMPLE_CATEGORY[NAMED_PAIR(三台,八座),NAMED_PAIR(恩光,天贵),OPEN_TAIL(等杂曜)])
records.reason: The source explicitly marks the examples as non-exhaustive with 等.

records.source_repair: Use the literal source surface 多见属火的星曜 rather than compressed 多见火曜.
records.normalized_expression: SAME_PALACE(GROUP(火铃)) AND [LOCATION(巳|午) OR CARDINAL_OPEN_CATEGORY(多见属火的星曜)]
records.reason: The source preserves both an open elemental category and a nonnumeric 多见 threshold.

records.normalized_expression: SAME_PALACE_SOURCE_LIST[铃星,陀罗,阴煞,华盖,天刑]
records.reason: Explicit membership names do not by themselves authorize ANY, ALL, or N_OF.
The punctuation/listing is preserved; no universal list quantifier is added.

records.source_repair: Restore parenthetical logic: 会禄 = 武曲化禄为上 / 禄存次之; source explicitly adds 或会天府化科.
records.normalized_expression: CO_OCCURRENCE[(TRANSFORM(武曲,化禄) OR ATOM(禄存)) OR TRANSFORM(天府,化科)]
records.reason: The source supplies both the local alternatives and the outer OR.
Adjacent 廉贞化禄/破军化禄 are realizations, but the source does not state an exhaustive closed membership for 见禄.
刑忌 is better represented as a preserved source compound than as an invented closed member set.
吉辅 is a favorable-support label; the source does not close membership, and 昌曲 is separately mentioned in the same sentence.
